sources.title: Sebb’s, Glasgow G1: ‘A delicious bombardment of continents, cuisines and cultural trickledowns’ – restaurant review
sources.description: Little bits of loveliness from Sauchiehall Street to the Silk Road, from a chef who wants to deliver maximum joy Sebb’s is a basement restaurant on Miller Street in Glasgow with a door that’s perilously easy to miss, even though it’s bright red. The first time I tried to find it, I waltzed past and almost ended up in the pants department of TK Maxx. I was luckier the second time around, and soon found myself descending a set of stairs into a room with the distinct vibe of a beatnik diner inside a bowling alley: there’s no natural light, there are booths that are perfect for conspiring in, a DJ playing psychedelic rock and food served in brown paper bags. The 13th Floor Elevators at noon on a Thursday?! Absolutely – as well as the globally ranging delights of sobrassada and ancho honey pitta, tandoori pork belly with tamarind chutney, barbecued squid with zhoug and preserved lemon aïoli, and trout ceviche with habanero, mango and tequila. It’s as if the Big Lebowski took up cooking. Sebb’s opened in late 2024, and just over a year later, head chef Danny Carruthers ’ food had already snagged the place a Michelin bib gourmand – to my mind by far the most interesting part of the whole tyre company’s advertising hoopla. Bibs are designed to reward places just like Sebb’s: odd, informal, intriguing – the type of place where you can pop out to for lunch without needing four spare hours, a booking months in advance and a decorative Patek Philippe watch on your wrist. supplement.title: 4条高铁将同日开通 多地迈入高铁时代

sources.title: 4条高铁将同日开通 多地迈入高铁时代
sources.description: 本报北京9月26日电(记者刘静)记者今天从中国国家铁路集团有限公司获悉，京港高铁雄安至商丘段、西渝高铁西安至安康段、宜昌至兴山高铁、哈尔滨至伊春高铁将于9月28日集中开通运营。4条线路横跨南北、纵贯东西，覆盖华北、东北、西北、华中四大区域，以350公里、250公里不同时速等级的钢铁动脉，打破地域时空壁垒，让多地正式迈入高铁时代。

sources.title: 驻泰国使馆提醒在泰中国公民防范强降雨及洪涝灾害
sources.description: 近日，泰国多地持续出现强降雨天气，曼谷及周边地区受影响较为明显。泰国气象局发布强降雨预警称，曼谷未来一段时间仍有大范围雷雨及局地大雨天气。9月26-27日，泰国中部包括曼谷及周边地区可能出现大雨至特大暴雨，提醒公众防范持续降雨引发的洪涝灾害。曼谷市政府宣布全市均为灾害影响区域，并启动防洪救灾指挥机制。
